categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo Jianan Electronics Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: smart metering and systems (including smart meters, electricity information collection terminals, IoT modules, data collection and billing software, and operation services), metering boxes and accessories (covering high/mid/low voltage metering boxes, meter shells, terminal shells, and internal accessories), and new energy equipment and system integration (including charging equipment, energy storage devices, and integrated microgrid systems combining photovoltaic, storage, charging, and distribution).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages microprocessor-based smart meters supporting bidirectional and tiered metering, load control, anti-theft, real-time monitoring, and communication functions. It employs standardized, modular, and platform-based rapid product development approaches. In charging and energy storage, it develops high-protection, long-life, high-reliability IP65 rated fast DC charging piles with advanced cooling and control technologies. Manufacturing integrates IoT technologies with an information platform (MOM system) connecting MES, CRM, SRM, PLM, ERP, OA, and WMS systems to realize Industry 4.0 and digital factory standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's key customers are major power grid enterprises, notably State Grid Corporation of China and China Southern Power Grid, which procure equipment through public tenders for smart meters and related devices. The products serve the electric power industry, including smart grid construction, energy metering, and electric vehicle charging infrastructure. The company also targets overseas markets, adapting products to international standards and expanding its global footprint.
categories.geographic_coverage: Ningbo Jianan primarily operates within China, with domestic sales accounting for over 97% of revenue. It has established subsidiaries and offices in Zhejiang Province and Hong Kong, and actively pursues overseas market expansion, including South America and Europe, with products certified to international standards.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the electric power supply chain, focusing on the research, development, manufacturing, and direct sales of smart metering devices, metering boxes, and new energy equipment. It maintains an integrated production and sales system, serving as a key equipment supplier to power grid operators and energy service providers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes innovation in new energy technologies aligned with China's new power system construction and carbon neutrality goals. R&D priorities include multi-energy complementary control, integrated photovoltaic-storage-charging-distribution microgrid systems, and advanced smart metering and charging technologies. The company invests heavily in R&D, maintains provincial-level innovation platforms, and participates actively in national standards development and industry collaborations.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of physical products, including smart meters, metering terminals, metering boxes, and new energy equipment. The company also derives income from software and system integration services related to energy data collection, billing, and microgrid management. Government subsidies and investment income contribute marginally to overall revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ningbo Jianan positions itself as a leading high-tech enterprise and a specialized 'little giant' in China's smart electric meter and new energy equipment manufacturing industry. It competes in a market with increasing demand driven by smart grid and new energy system investments. The company distinguishes itself through strong R&D capabilities, quality certifications, and participation in national standard-setting, securing a premium supplier status to major grid companies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.014 billion, representing an 11.46% year-over-year increase, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 193 million, up 25.49%. Total assets reached RMB 1.617 billion, growing 24.61% from the prior year. The company maintains a healthy cash flow with operating cash inflows exceeding RMB 1.14 billion. It has steadily increased R&D investment, accounting for nearly 5% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ningbo Jianan emphasizes technology leadership, product quality, and rapid responsiveness to customer needs. Its products feature advanced functionalities such as bidirectional metering, anti-theft, and real-time data communication. The company integrates smart manufacturing and digital management systems to ensure high efficiency and quality. It also offers comprehensive energy management solutions combining metering, charging, storage, and microgrid integration, supporting customers' digital transformation and carbon reduction objectives.
